Metadata.title: Fi Sikkati — Find people already going your way
Metadata.description: Community ride-sharing for El Obour City and nearby areas. Drivers publish the trips they already plan to make; passengers find one going their way and request a seat.

Pwa.bannerBody: Install Fi Sikkati on your home screen — it opens like a real app.
Pwa.bannerBodyIos: On iPhone: open in Safari and tap Install — we will show how to add the icon.
Pwa.iosBody: Apple does not allow one-tap install. Use Safari and these steps:
Pwa.iosSafariOnly: Important: open the site in Safari, not Chrome or another browser.
Pwa.iosStep1: Tap the <share>Share</share> button in Safari (square with an upward arrow).
Pwa.iosStep2: Scroll and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
Pwa.iosStep3: Tap “Add” — the Fi Sikkati icon appears with your apps.

welcome.title: Find people already going your way
welcome.body: Fi Sikkati is not a taxi. Neighbours publish the trip they are already taking, and you ask for a seat in the same direction.

passenger.title: If you are riding
passenger.body: Search by where you are, where you are going, and when. Ask for a seat and wait for the driver to accept. After that you can chat and call.

driver.title: If you are driving
driver.body: Confirm your identity and your car, publish the trip and the empty seats, and accept passengers who are already on your route.

start.title: One account for both
start.body: Sign in as a passenger or a driver. It is the same account, and after approval you can drive and publish trips.

Landing.headline: Find people already going your way.
Landing.subheadline: Not a taxi, not a car on demand. Neighbours heading the same way publish their trips, and you find the one that fits your route and your timing, then ask for a seat.
Landing.statusNote: Search, request a seat, chat with the driver, and rate the trip — all inside the app.

preview.label: Published trips
preview.empty: No published trips right now. Sign in to search, or publish your own.
preview.signInHint: Sign in to request a seat on any trip.

difference.title: Why this is not a taxi app
difference.body: Nobody orders a car here. The trip already exists — we give you a safe, structured way to join it.

notTaxi.title: The trip exists first
notTaxi.body: The driver is going anyway. You share an empty seat instead of summoning a car.

routeMatch.title: Matched by route
routeMatch.body: We compare your way with the trip's route and timing, so you only see drivers actually heading your direction.

neighbours.title: People from your area
neighbours.body: Verified accounts from the El Obour community, with mutual ratings after every trip.

Landing.howItWorksBody: From publishing a trip to rating it, every step happens inside the app.

publish.title: A driver publishes a trip
publish.body: Origin, destination, departure time and the number of free seats.

discover.title: Passengers find it
discover.body: Search by where you are, where you're going and when; results rank by how close the route is.

join.title: Request, accept, ride
join.body: Ask for a seat, the driver accepts, you talk inside the trip, then rate each other.

Landing.trustTitle: Built for a community, not a marketplace
Landing.trustBody: Trust isn't a slogan here — it's deliberate steps before, during and after every trip.

verified.title: Verified identities
verified.body: Drivers and riders are checked before their first trip, and the badge shows on the profile.

pickup.title: Approximate pickup points
pickup.body: Your exact location stays hidden until your request is accepted.

chat.title: Chat inside the trip
chat.body: Every detail lives in one place tied to the trip, not lost in a group thread.

report.title: Reporting and blocking
report.body: Bad behaviour can be reported, reviewed by moderators and acted on.

closing.title: Let's make the El Obour commute easier
closing.body: Create an account, confirm your email and mobile, then search for a trip or publish your own.
closing.note: This is a trial build. Search, publishing and chat work after you sign in.

Legal.termsP1: Fi Sikkati is a community route-matching service, not a taxi or ride-hailing marketplace. Drivers publish trips they already plan to make; passengers request seats. Nobody is dispatched a car.
Legal.termsP2: You must be 18 or older. You are responsible for the information you provide, for how you behave on trips, and for any cash arrangement you make off the platform. The service does not take payments in this version.
Legal.termsP3: We may suspend or close accounts that abuse the community. These terms are the version you accept at registration; a lawyer-reviewed production text will replace them before public launch.
Legal.privacyP1: We collect the account data you submit (name, email, date of birth, optional phone and city) to operate the service. Email is the sign-in identifier. Phone numbers are stored unverified until an SMS provider is separately approved.
Legal.privacyP2: Passwords are stored as Argon2id hashes. Session cookies are HttpOnly. Identity and vehicle documents are stored in a private bucket, visible only to administrators through short-lived audited links, and purged 30 days after a decision.
Legal.privacyP3: You can close your account from settings. After a grace period the profile is anonymised; security audit records are kept. This notice is the version you accept at registration.

HowItWorks.title: The trip exists first.
paragraphs: A driver who is already going from A to B publishes the trip: time, seats, and the route.
Passengers search by pickup, drop-off and time. Results rank by how well the route fits.
Ask for a seat. When the driver accepts, you chat in the trip thread and share the ride.
After the trip completes, you can rate each other. Nobody orders a car here.

PublicSafety.title: Trust steps, not a guarantee.
paragraphs: Identity and driver documents are reviewed before the first shared ride.
You can report a user, a trip or a message, and block someone silently.
Exact home addresses stay hidden. Pickup points are shown only to accepted parties.
Fi Sikkati is not an emergency service and never claims guaranteed physical safety.

Faq.title: Common questions
paragraphs: Is this a taxi app? No. Drivers publish trips they already plan to make.
How do I pay? The amount is a suggested contribution. No money moves through the app.
Who can see my phone? Only if you opt in to share it with accepted trip peers.
How do I become a driver? Verify identity, add a vehicle and licence, then wait for review.

About.title: Built for the El Obour community
paragraphs: Fi Sikkati started because WhatsApp groups bury the useful trip messages.
We give neighbours a structured way to publish, find, join and remember rides.
The product is community ride-sharing and route matching — not ride-hailing.

Assistant.title: Ask Fi Sikkati
Assistant.body: I can explain the product or help you phrase a search. I never book a seat.
Assistant.unavailable: The assistant is off or busy. Try again later.

Contact.title: Talk to the operators
paragraphs: For account or trip problems, use the in-app report flow so there is an audit trail.
Community admins — the original WhatsApp group owners — review verifications and reports.
Email for legal notices is published in the privacy policy.
